data.body: Review-finding remediation commit b493118a04cc1004b0b8b1a3f84d4b8fc5ea9c27 corrects only three documentation claims: bounded response latency belongs to preview_or_job rather than direct preview_criterion; resolve_value now documents secret expressions; and the code-review workflow reserves determinism for its scripted decision while stating escalation cannot change the verdict. Prose-only structural oracle PASS on all three paths; 97 focused tests PASS; scoped Ruff and format, comment hygiene, commit-ticket, DCO, Change-Id, and diff-integrity checks PASS. Per operator direction, no full suite was run; Gerrit CI supplies Verified. Pushed as Gerrit change 2961 with session hashtag. A fresh independent exact-SHA review is still required before merge/closure.
